description: Askari Life Assurance Company Limited was incorporated in Pakistan on 18 August 1992 and is engaged in the life insurance business, including ordinary life business and accidental and health business. Army Welfare Trust is its parent company. It sells through its own branch network and through bancassurance arrangements with Askari Bank Limited and United Bank Limited, and its own site reports more than 250,000 policyholders.
